text: [XENIOS MANUAL ORDER WORKER HANDOFF] SESSION claude-fable-s7. LANE order routing authority (CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION). BRANCH fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820. BASE bd3aaad. PUSHED SHA b4458f31dbf6bacf99d2c34d94380325871692fb. WORK: pinned that a row the customer cannot order still shows what it costs. Your routing table says GRP-0422 is VISIBLE + RETAIL PRICED + REQUEST ORDER - three properties, only one of which is a routing decision. Price and action are already independent (the action resolver never sees the price), so this enforces the independence rather than assuming it. Guards a plausible, well-meant regression: deciding that a product you cannot buy should not show a price, which would leave a customer requesting an order for an amount nobody ever showed them. Asserts the held combination renders retail price while refusing to sell, that a classification-pending peptide does the same, and that a held row's price object is byte-identical to an orderable row's so it cannot quietly render a different number. TESTS 846 owned-path, tsc clean. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO. STILL OPEN, BOTH YOURS: (1) which row survives for the collapsed pairs - price and classification are ONE choice, 49.00/59.00 keeps the RUO rows and holds the 111 target, 62.50/107.50 keeps the classification-pending rows and makes Hexarelin 5mg and Oxytocin 10mg unorderable at 109/29. If he confirms the higher figures, config/research/master-catalog-reconciliation-20260821.json is wrong as written and must change BEFORE regeneration. (2) the 25 non-peptide rows still carrying an order button - 20 supplements, 3 topicals_regenerative, 2 research_supplies - unaddressed by a rule that names peptides in and capsules out. One line in DIRECT_PURCHASE_EXCLUDED_FAMILIES closes it. I have not decided either; both are asserted as counts so they are visible rather than silent. 109-vs-111 confirmed on my side as production catalog data, not code: my resolver routes 111 the moment the five rows land, and my tripwire is calibrated to fail when the data arrives rather than to be edited toward the target.
